goal_card_draft.title: Review the exhibit-room operating notes
goal_card_draft.goal: Turn the complete supplied exhibit-room notes into a reusable cited review checklist. Separate requirements, their applicability conditions, exceptions and unresolved questions. Preserve the scope and direction of each relationship and identify what the notes leave unspecified.
known: The only factual source for this use is the single explicitly bound material.
unresolved: Do not resolve unspecified behavior, precedence or choices from common sense; report the uncertainty with its source basis.
constraints: Use only the bound material; do not add outside facts or duties.
Retain all substantive obligations, qualifiers, exceptions and explicit open choices.
Attach exact source citations to each item and make condition/exception targets explicit where the text supports them.
Preserve conjunctions, timing, negation, scope and what an acknowledgement changes.
A machine-valid shape or matching quote does not establish semantic correctness or human acceptance.
acceptance_checks: An independent person checks every substantive source statement for completeness and fidelity.
Every citation refers to the current bound material and supports the meaning and relationship claimed.
Conditions and exceptions point to the right requirement without reversing applicability or broadening scope.
Explicit and relevant unspecified matters remain unresolved; no inferred behavior is presented as a source requirement.
The saved result and review belong to the same actual Run; manual acceptance remains PENDING until a person explicitly decides.

goal_card_draft.title: Review the practice-station labelling notes
goal_card_draft.goal: Create a cited checklist from the complete supplied station-labelling notes. Distinguish requirements, applicability conditions, exceptions and unanswered questions. Preserve necessary conditions as necessary conditions, and keep unknown permissions, durations and precedence open.
known: The only factual source for this use is the single explicitly bound material.
unresolved: Use the notes as the evidence for unresolved issues; do not invent an authority, duration, precedence or sufficient condition.
constraints: Use only the bound material and preserve all substantive statements.
Do not equate a recorded inspection with a passing inspection or invent a sufficient condition for ready.
Keep conditional relationships, exceptions and their supported targets explicit with exact source citations.
Do not fill in the open relation between a reservation and a damaged guard.
A machine-valid shape or matching quote does not establish semantic correctness or human acceptance.
acceptance_checks: An independent person checks coverage of every requirement, condition, exception and stated open question.
Each citation supports the claim and the relationship and belongs to the current material version.
The distinction between necessary and sufficient conditions, inspection records and pass results remains intact.
Unstated authority, duration and conflicting-label precedence remain unresolved.
